verdict.rationale: Greenhouse is an ATS that holds candidate data, so data-retention and deletion controls are a fair axis, but the evidence pack documents no retention policies, purge settings, or user-facing deletion controls. The only nearby items are adjacent features: an 'Application deleted' webhook event notification, an API to update candidate information, and an audit log listed on the pricing page. None of these is a documented capability for controlling retention or deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
